args.query: Task: active employee count over time department wise. Produce MySQL 8 SQL for annual point-in-time headcounts from earliest dept_emp.from_date year through current year. Snapshot at December 31 for past years and CURDATE() for current year. Active means from_date <= snapshot_date AND to_date > snapshot_date (exclusive end; 9999-01-01 is ongoing). Include every department even if zero. Prefer efficient aggregated +1 assignment start / -1 assignment end events and cumulative sum at annual snapshots rather than expensive range joins; count active department assignments using the unique emp_no,dept_no rows. Return snapshot_date, dept_name, active_employee_count ordered by snapshot_date,dept_name.

```sql
WITH annual_snapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(dept_emp.from_date)) YEAR)) AS snapshot_year,
        LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(dept_emp.from_date)) YEAR)) AS snapshot_date
    FROM 
        dept_emp
    WHERE 
        dept_emp.from_date <= CURDATE() 
        AND (dept_emp.to_date > CURDATE() OR dept_emp.to_date = '9999-01-01')
    GROUP BY 
        snapshot_year
),
events AS (
    SELECT 
        d.dept_no,
        d.dept_name,
        e.snapshot_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN de.from_date <= e.snapshot_date AND (de.to_date > e.snapshot_date OR de.to_date = '9999-01-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_employee_count
    FROM 
        departments d
    CROSS JOIN 
        annual_snapshots e
    LEFT JOIN 
        dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
    GROUP BY 
        d.dept_no, d.dept_name, e.snapshot_date
)
SELECT 
    e.snapshot_date, 
    e.dept_name, 
    COALESCE(e.active_employee_count, 0) AS active_employee_count
FROM 
    events e
ORDER BY 
    e.snapshot_date, 
    e.dept_name;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT YEAR(MIN(from_date)) AS y 
    FROM dept_emp 
    WHERE from_date <= CURDATE() 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT y + 1 
    FROM years 
    WHERE y < YEAR(CURDATE())
), 
snapshots AS (
    SELECT CASE 
        WHEN y = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN CURDATE() 
        ELSE STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(y, '-12-31'), '%Y-%m-%d') 
    END AS snapshot_date 
    FROM years 
    WHERE y IS NOT NULL
), 
annual_deltas AS (
    SELECT dept_no, YEAR(from_date) AS y, COUNT(*) AS delta 
    FROM dept_emp 
    WHERE from_date <= CURDATE() 
    GROUP BY dept_no, YEAR(from_date) 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT dept_no, YEAR(to_date) AS y, -COUNT(*) AS delta 
    FROM dept_emp 
    WHERE to_date <= CURDATE() 
    GROUP BY dept_no, YEAR(to_date)
), 
net_deltas AS (
    SELECT dept_no, y, SUM(delta) AS delta 
    FROM annual_deltas 
    GROUP BY dept_no, y
) 
SELECT s.snapshot_date, d.dept_name, 
       SUM(COALESCE(n.delta, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.dept_no ORDER BY s.snapshot_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS active_employee_count 
FROM snapshots s 
CROSS JOIN departments d 
LEFT JOIN net_deltas n ON n.dept_no = d.dept_no AND n.y = YEAR(s.snapshot_date) 
ORDER BY s.snapshot_date, d.dept_name;
```
